Class TurKeycloakAdminService

java.lang.Object
com.viglet.turing.service.keycloak.TurKeycloakAdminService
@Service public class TurKeycloakAdminService extends Object
Calls the Keycloak Admin REST API to list users and groups for the realm configured under spring.security.oauth2.client.provider.keycloak.issuer-uri.

Authentication is delegated to the currently logged-in user's OIDC access token, which must carry sufficient permissions in Keycloak (typically a realm-management role such as view-users / query-groups). When the user is not authenticated via Keycloak this service throws IllegalStateException.
